stories.title: Russia launches 948 drones at Ukraine in largest attack over 24-hour period
stories.summary: Russia launched 948 drones at Ukraine over a 24-hour period in what is described as the largest such attack, striking cities across western Ukraine, damaging residential buildings and injuring multiple people.

stories.title: Everyday life in Asia is being upended by Iran war fuel crisis
stories.summary: The ongoing conflict involving Iran has disrupted oil and gas supplies from the Gulf region, causing fuel shortages and rising prices that are affecting daily life across Asia.

stories.title: Israel says it will take control of large buffer zone in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: Israel's defence minister announced that Israel will assume control of a large buffer zone in southern Lebanon and that displaced Lebanese residents will not be permitted to return until northern Israel is deemed safe.

stories.title: Palestinian FA calls for Israeli ban after FIFA discrimination report
stories.summary: The Palestinian Football Association has called for Israel to be banned from FIFA after the Israel Football Association was fined by the governing body for racism and discrimination violations following a Palestinian-submitted report.

stories.title: Israeli defences questioned as Iran continues to cause damage
stories.summary: Iranian missile strikes have caused damage in Israel, prompting questions about the effectiveness of Israel's air defence systems.

stories.title: Aid flotilla reaches Cuba amid US oil blockade and blackouts
stories.summary: An aid flotilla has arrived in Cuba as the country faces severe fuel shortages and widespread power blackouts resulting from a US-imposed oil blockade.

stories.title: Iranian IRGC’s ties to Hezbollah deepen tensions in Lebanese politics
stories.summary: Lebanon's prime minister stated that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps is commanding Hezbollah, with analysts confirming the Iranian organization is directing the group's activities, deepening tensions in Lebanese politics.

stories.title: Israeli strike hits Tyre during Al Jazeera report
stories.summary: An Israeli missile struck a waterfront building in the Lebanese city of Tyre during a live Al Jazeera broadcast, disrupting the journalist's report.

stories.title: Moment rescuers find man alive under the rubble in Tehran
stories.summary: Rescuers in Tehran pulled a man alive from rubble after US-Israeli strikes hit a residential area in the Iranian capital.

stories.title: UN experts urge Israel to free Gaza doctor amid reports of ‘severe torture’
stories.summary: UN special rapporteurs have called on Israel to release detained Gaza doctor Hussam Abu Safia, warning that he has been systematically denied medical treatment and reporting allegations of severe torture.

stories.title: Philippines declares energy emergency over Iran conflict

stories.title: Keir Starmer’s policy on the Iran war is a recipe for catastrophe

stories.title: Is the US talking to Iran’s Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, and who is he?

stories.title: Why has India arrested US, Ukrainian nationals under ‘anti-terror’ laws?

stories.title: Israel’s Smotrich calls for ‘new border’ and occupation of south Lebanon

stories.title: The tragic toll of Sudan’s destroyed healthcare

stories.title: Qatar’s foreign affairs ministry stresses need for regional coexistence

stories.summary: Royal Challengers Bengaluru, the 2025 Indian Premier League champions, announced they will leave 11 seats empty at their stadium to honor the victims of a recent stampede.

stories.title: The US should end the war asap

stories.title: Inside the alleged Russian operation to trigger anti-government protests in Angola

stories.title: UK universities flock to India - but will they succeed?

stories.title: BTS Arirang review: K-pop idols rekindle their fire

stories.title: Car stolen with two-month-old baby inside
